# SPOOLES 2.2 source

All 1809 regular archive members are retained byte-for-byte under `src/` from
https://www.netlib.org/linalg/spooles/spooles.2.2.tgz (retrieved 2 November 2026).
Archive SHA-256: `a84559a0e987a1e423055ef4fdf3035d55b65bbe4bf915efaa1a35bef7f8c5dd`.
The source manifest records every member. Original documentation
`src/documentation/ReferenceManual/main.tex:128` describes the release as public
domain. Preserve those original notices and documentation; do not relabel it
with the root application license.

Pristine sources are unchanged. The disposable native build overlay configures
Make.inc and fixes the documented Tree filename plus three integer NULL arguments.
See `ThirdParty/Build/calculix-cpu.py` and its retained build report. Recovery of
this source alone is not a public binary distribution/source-closure approval.
